q: Do I need to be home?
a: No. Most clients leave a key, a lockbox code or a door code when they book. You can also be home if you'd rather.

q: How do you look after my key?
a: Keys live in a locked key safe at our base. Each one has a coded tag with no name or address, so a lost key can't be traced to your home.

q: What happens to my alarm or door code?
a: It's stored with your booking, seen only by your cleaner and our office, and deleted when your service ends.

q: Who will come to my home?
a: One of our own employed cleaners, not a subcontractor. Every cleaner holds a current national police check and has passed an interview and a paid trial clean.

q: Do you bring your own supplies?
a: Yes, all products and equipment, including a vacuum and mop. If you'd like us to use your own products, leave them out and add a note.

q: Can I cancel or move a clean?
a: Yes. With at least 48 hours' notice there's no charge. With less notice there's a $50 late-change fee, because your cleaner has set aside the time.

q: What if you can't get in?
a: Your cleaner calls you and waits 20 minutes. After that there's a $60 lockout fee and we rebook the clean.

q: Do you clean offices after hours?
